description: Permanently delete a link and its files. Account owners can delete their links; anonymous callers need the manage_token. This cannot be undone.

manage_token.description: Secret manage token returned when the link was created (lets anonymous callers manage it).

slug.description: The link name, e.g. "k3x9pq" (a full https://putit.online/<name> URL also works).

name: delete_link
title: Delete a link
